# Desk Tasks
A synthetic offline CLI for one support coordinator. No dependencies, external service, secrets or customer data.
Run `node bin/tasks.mjs --owner mina`; `npm test` checks the current behavior and `npm run build` checks JavaScript syntax.
Open tasks can be filtered with shared query functions. The reminder view already uses those functions.
Dates are date-only ISO YYYY-MM-DD values, compared lexically after validation. "Before" excludes the cutoff date. Tasks without dates and completed tasks are not due.
Existing unfiltered CLI output is a supported interface.

The target is the current repository. No real provider, external research, package installation, email sending, commit, PR or deployment. I want the local UI and API implemented, built, tested and inspected.

reply_policies.when: The command asks for the desired business outcome, owner, success measure, or framing approval.
reply_policies.reply: I own this synthetic pilot. Real time saved and customer impact are hypotheses, not measured results.

reply_policies.when: The command presents product alternatives and asks for a product-solution decision.
reply_policies.reply: Choose agent-requested draft suggestions in the ticket workspace, with review and editing before copying. I reject automatic sending and a separate chat app. Keep the inbox useful without AI.

reply_policies.reply: Finish with the local pilot handoff. Real-model quality, real authentication, CI, staging and deployment are not established by this exercise. Keep any remaining local defect or missing render evidence explicit; do not call those checks passed.

# Invoice Preview
Offline invoice tools for a synthetic desktop workflow.
Run `node bin/invoice.mjs samples/invoice.json`, `npm test`, `npm run build`.
The CLI currently reads a local JSON invoice and prints the export representation. The shared formatter is also imported by src/export-view.mjs; those bytes are the compatibility contract.
The proposed --preview mode must display the same representation without saving, changing an invoice, or invoking an external application.
Constraints: air-gapped machine, one Node process, no new package or service, no data or public-format migration. The decision concerns only where preview orchestration belongs. It does not certify the rest of the invoicing system.
All identities and amounts are fictional.

cases.prompt: {INVOCATION} --design Design Reserve Desk's next architecture from the supplied prototype and product goals. We need durable multi-instance reservations, safe retries and a reliable notification handoff without building an operations-heavy platform. The target is cwd. Show the architectural choices and the path from a request to a confirmed reservation, then a practical implementation handoff. This is synthetic local design work only: no external research, provider access, installation, production-code edits, load tests, commit or deployment.

reply_policies.reply: I own the design. Confirmation means durable stock reservation, not merely queued intent. Accept delayed notification but never overselling or cross-tenant access. The numbers in README are planning targets and assumptions, not measured results. Two engineers and modest operations remain the constraint.

reply_policies.when: The command presents candidate shapes and asks for approval of decision criteria and weights.
reply_policies.reply: Approve correctness and tenant isolation 40, operational simplicity 25, latency and throughput 20, evolvability 15. Treat the confirmation and durability requirements as hard constraints before preferences.

reply_policies.reply: Choose transaction-backed authoritative inventory with idempotent reservation records and a durable notification handoff. I accept notification delay and contention handling; I do not accept acknowledging queued intent as confirmed stock. Keep any unmeasured capacity or recovery promise explicit.

base_files.README.md:
# Reserve Desk architecture exercise
Synthetic single-process prototype; no external service, credentials or real orders.
Run `npm test` and `npm run build`. These verify prototype behavior only.
The proposed product will run two API instances against durable inventory. Product goals supplied by the exercise owner:
- A confirmed reservation reduces authoritative available stock once, survives a process restart, and can be retrieved by its owning tenant.
- Repeating the same request after an uncertain response must not reserve stock twice; another tenant using the same client key is a separate operation.
- Two buyers competing for the last unit cannot both receive a confirmed reservation.
- Notification failure must not reverse a confirmed reservation. Operators need to distinguish an unconfirmed request from a confirmed reservation with pending notification.
Planning assumptions, not measured capacity: 25 reservation requests/second normally, bursts of 500/second for 30 seconds, and up to 50/second on one SKU. Target end-to-end p95 is 250ms for confirmation.
Two engineers operate this service. Prefer at most one managed data service and modest operational work. This is a design decision, not approval to install, buy, migrate, load test, deploy or contact providers.
The local prototype trusts a single process and has no durability, real authentication or notification-delivery guarantee. It is evidence of current interfaces, not a production baseline.

# Current boundaries
The caller passes a trusted tenant identifier to a local library. The library alone writes its two in-memory maps; its reserve method performs no await between stock check and decrement.
A real HTTP authentication boundary, durable transaction, restart recovery, shared datastore and notification handoff do not exist.
A notification is a separate optional synthetic function; current reservation code does not call it.

# Invoice read API
Synthetic local API functions; no server, external services, secrets or production authentication.
Run `npm test` and `npm run build`. The sessions passed to readInvoice are assumed authenticated by the surrounding application; missing sessions are rejected here.
Contract: a tenant may read only its own invoice. Unknown or another tenant's invoice returns 404. An explicit tax rate of zero means tax-exempt, not a missing value. Amounts are integer cents.
This change is a local implementation simplification; the contract is unchanged.
